title: Capiba — Ingestão (platform_metrics)
description: Duração, volume e erros de validação dos pipelines declarativos, lidos da tabela gold platform_metrics (escrita pelo runner a cada run).

options.content: Fonte: tabela Iceberg `gold.capiba.platform_metrics` (uma linha por step de cada run de pipeline, escrita por `run_pipeline` via `write_platform_metrics`). Consultas via datasource Trino.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dt, run_id, pipeline, step, round(duration_s, 2) AS duration_s FROM gold.capiba.platform_metrics WHERE dt >= format_datetime(current_date - interval '7' day, 'YYYY-MM-dd') ORDER BY dt DESC, pipeline, step
SELECT dt, pipeline, sum(rows_out) AS rows_out FROM gold.capiba.platform_metrics WHERE step LIKE 'crawl_%' OR step LIKE 'collect_%' OR step = 'normalize' GROUP BY dt, pipeline ORDER BY dt DESC
SELECT dt, pipeline, sum(validation_errors) AS validation_errors FROM gold.capiba.platform_metrics GROUP BY dt, pipeline HAVING sum(validation_errors) > 0 ORDER BY dt DESC
